_comment: The sneak-past-the-ambush proof. Loads near_ambush_sneak (warrior L1, [Stealth]+[Appraise Foe] QA-fixture-granted, floodplains at (30,16) facing down) via title Continue. Toggles [Stealth] ON (hotbar_2), walks the REAL goblin_encounter_1 Chebyshev-2 zone (O2) all the way to standing adjacent to it -- assert_event_absent proves combat_started never fires anywhere in that approach, the whole point of the seam. Breaks sneak with a genuine field-skill use ON A TARGET ([Appraise Foe], hotbar_3, faced at the ambush entity itself -- a harmless flavor read, not an attack): sneak_ended + the off-toast fire BEFORE observe's own skill_used/toast, matching the break-condition ordering. The POSITIVE CONTROL is the very next step: still standing inside the same Chebyshev-2 zone but no longer sneaking, one more move fires the ambush for real (_check_trigger_radius no longer skips) -- proving the skip was `sneaking` itself, not merely having already been inside the zone once. Ends right after combat_started (mid-combat by design, the combat_move_input/relc_tutorial precedent) -- no fight is resolved here. Fixture rng_state is cosmetic (no fight completes), seed 9 for convention; no seed search needed.
